name: Partial-Cube Minor
definition: A pc-minor of a partial cube G is obtained by a finite sequence of restrictions to nonempty convex subgraphs and contractions of Θ-classes, where contracting a Θ-class simultaneously identifies the endpoints of all its edges and takes the underlying simple quotient graph.
comments: The elementary coordinate operations are restriction to a semicube and contraction of a Θ-class. This notion is different from an ordinary graph minor.
